name: pad
expr: r1 = double(strlength(pad("hi", 5))); d = pad({'a','bbb'}); nd = numel(d); d1n = strlength(d{1}); d2n = strlength(d{2}); d1c = double(d{1}(2)); cn = pad({'a','bb'},4); cn1n = strlength(cn{1}); lf = pad({'a','bb'},4,'left'); lf1c = double(lf{1}(1)); bt = pad({'a','bb'},4,'both','*'); bt11 = double(bt{1}(1)); bt12 = double(bt{1}(2)); cc = pad({'a';'bbb'}); nr = size(cc,1); nco = size(cc,2);
comment: Sig: pad(s[,n][,side[,char]]). DEEP-PROBE 2026-05-31: added (a) CELL-ARRAY str support (was throwing 'Not a char array') — element-wise -> cell of char vectors, same shape, each padded to the SAME width n; (b) the default-width form (n omitted) — for a cell the longest element, for a scalar its own length: pad({'a','bbb'})={'a  ','bbb'} (both width 3). pad({'a','bb'},4,'both','*')={'*a**','*bb*'} (extra split floor-left/ceil-right). A string 2nd arg is the side with default width. Scalar char/string path unchanged. Spec-extension batch 2026-05-09.
